verdict.rationale: Tilled offers white-label functionality and custom domains for its API, onboarding, and reporting console (Enterprise only), plus a 'build your own UI' option. Seller-facing evidence is limited to onboarding (OnboardingJS) and a DisputesAPI for custom dispute experiences. The branded console is a hosted surface that stays within the Tilled login experience, not embedded components, and payouts are documented only through the Dashboard. missing for 10: embeddable white-label components for balances, payouts, and transaction history; documented APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history to build in-product seller views; white-labeling outside the Enterprise tier; independent corroboration.
